scope: Two fair D04-only DEV rows for the approved adaptive exact source-time-tree reuse. No unchanged baseline rerun, new domain, main experiment or holdout.

model.provenance: Existing Shandong DEV physical model retained; no battery/consumption change to induce multiple charging

resources.map_preparation_accounting: Separate wall/CPU/RSS; no free N-squared selected-leg table; selected legs refined on demand

accounting.policy: Carry prior charged use; conservatively charge 60s for native correctness/dev microchecks, then all observed fresh worker CPU including compiler/cold load. Preparation separate. No retries or budget extension.

selection_assessment.rule: Existing D04 domain only; exact prior input digest required. No geographic expansion.

routing_policy.trigger: For a non-origin source, cumulative uncached old-potential A* edge relaxations reach the full graph edge count; build its full forward time tree on the next pair miss that needs it.
routing_policy.construction_accounting: Dynamic query work, included in loaded query limit and native leg/scalar timers; no new persistent cache outside the existing scalar LRU.
routing_policy.ties: Use the exact source distances as a consistent reverse A* potential, retain strict-greater cutoff and the complete equality contour; reconstruct the existing canonical node/edge path and actual length.

correctness_before_dev: Independent tiny directed all-pair path/parallel/Unicode/tie parity with repeated promotions
Two-slot LRU eviction and subsequent rebuild
Interruption during full-tree construction and equality-DAG search; discard partial caches
Strong/Scale seed, full-key and primary/secondary-unattainment parity on finite common domains
interpretation: Exactly two new unprofiled 120s rows, 60s target threshold; single numerical worker/thread and existing memory/headroom guards. Preserve all prior UNKNOWN and timing evidence. No net-time or completion inference from offline sketches.
